race.comment: Another handy little race and GOLD CHARIOT (3) looks to get the right run behind the pace. He won two on the bounce impressively before looming up as the winner out to 1800m last time and just peaking on his run. The winner there has won again since and back to a mile should suit better. KASTUN STAR (11) has returned in good shape this preparation. Opened with a third at Tatura two starts back then landed the prize by 2.75 lengths last time out over 1500m at Mornington. Nicely placed to take this out. FINANCE SHOGUN (9) is stepping up in trip after finishing fifth over 1415m at Sale last time out. Each-way. KING'S CORONATION (7) won fresh then made a reasonable effort last time, finishing 1.75 lengths back in sixth over 1415m at Sale. In the mix.
